description: Ministerio de Salud Pública (MSP), Uruguay publishes the register of long-stay establishments for older people (ELEPEM) that meet the ministry requirements: the establishments authorised for a period of five years and those certified in recent years, published as CSV, XLSX and XML tables with a metadata file, under the Fifth Open Government Action Plan commitment on transparency. Coverage: Uruguay nationally; the portal record was last modified on 2024-07-29. Format and access: CSV, XLSX, XML, JSON, downloadable without registration from the Uruguay national open data catalogue; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licencia de DAG de Uruguay; cost: free. Caveats: only establishments that meet the requirements are listed, so unauthorised homes are absent; the files were not opened, so columns, counts and whether coordinates are given are unconfirmed. Simulation uses: facility layers for vulnerable-population evacuation and heat-wave or flood exposure studies of care homes, and healthcare capacity mapping. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
